thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] sev2: sustained high log volume containing unredacted request payloads from tenant=harborbank in dedicated-pool-aurora-3 · triggered at 2026-06-12T03:17:56Z

james: paging oncall (i'm oncall) — seeing errors + huge log spikes from that pool. tagging oncall handoff. I'm taking first responder.

maria: oncall handover acked. i'm following, will check routing + ingress filters.

james: quick summary — customer HarborBank (enterprise, VPC) reported elevated debug logs during a rollout. Looks like a misconfigured debug flag flipped on a sidecar, so request bodies (PII) are being emitted. Need immediate contain & assess retention exposure.

raj: copying infra notes — the sidecar config was rolled via configmap rollout ~02:45Z. I can patch to stop logging. Suggest we pause writes from that pool to the ELK ingest and start writing to a quarantine bucket for analysis.

maria: commands to pause ingest:```bash
# disable sidecar verbose
kubectl -n pools patch deploy dedicated-pool-aurora-3 -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"sidecar.debug":"false"}}}}}'
# stop fluentd forwarder on node(s)
kubectl -n infra delete pod fluentd-collector-aurora-3-0
```

james: did patch, sidecar debug now false. logs dropping rapidly. still seeing existing 10GB of unredacted logs in the live index.

elain: (legal) pinged — we need details: what PII fields, how long retained, and a proposed short retention/chain-of-custody plan. Do not share raw logs in regular channels.

james: understood. initial scan shows request_body.* fields (ssn, account_number, customer_name) in cleartext in ~2.5k request records. Affected window ~02:30Z–03:10Z.

liz: cs/pm notified HarborBank PMO (harbor-cust-pmo) and asked for escalation channel. They asked for an immediate incident call and to confirm whether logs were exported to external partners.

harbor-cust-pmo: thanks for the heads up. our security team wants copies for forensics. we require redacted copies and a statement of retention duration.

james: proposal: create a secure ephemeral bucket (s3://rwd-incident-quarantine/harborbank/1852509876) with restricted KMS key, copy the raw index there for legal & customer review, set lifecycle 7 days, and run automated redaction pipeline — but we need a documented redaction exception to hold unredacted data for 72 hours while legal/forensics examine.

elain: legal comments: we can approve a limited retention exception but need: (1) explicit approval by customer (written), (2) ACLs/Audit logs enabled, (3) list of persons with access, (4) deletion confirmation after window. We also require a memo for the compliance log.

raj: infra checklist I ran: snapshot index harborbank-requests-20260612-02 -> /tmp/index-snap.tar.gz, tar copied to internal secure host. Proposed copy command:```bash
curl -sS -XPOST "https://elastic.internal/_snapshot/incident_quarantine/snap-1852509876/_restore" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ELASTIC_INCIDENT_TOKEN'
aws s3 cp /tmp/index-snap.tar.gz s3://rwd-incident-quarantine/harborbank/1852509876 --sse aws:kms --profile internal
```

maria: also toggled ingest to quarantine pipeline that strips non-whitelisted header fields — but note: the index already has plaintext bodies. The pipeline can redact token patterns for the copied artifacts but we need the unredacted for forensics per legal.

james: live mitigation steps completed: sidecar debug off, fluentd restart to purge forwarders, ingest paused. Customer-facing status: partial mitigation, no external exports detected. Still need legal signoff for short-term retention.

elain: please collect the minimal dataset for investigation. Who will be on the access list?

james: access list proposed: james (oncall), raj (infra), elaine (legal), liz (cs), two named harbor bank IR contacts (via harbors-cust-pmo). I'll add a short access justification for the compliance memo.

harbor-cust-pmo: we can provide written consent if you provide the retention window and safeguards. please confirm deletion timeline and that only listed people can decrypt.

elain: approved conditionally: 72-hour retention of unredacted logs in quarantine bucket with strict ACLs and KMS key rotation disabled until deletion, full audit trail. After 72h data to be securely wiped and a signed deletion certificate provided to customer. We need the internal memo circulated and signed by SOC lead.

raj: executing data copy now. I will: snapshot -> upload -> tag with incident id -> set bucket policy to restrict to listed principals -> enable S3 server access logs. Will send command output over secure vault.

maria: redaction plan for copies shared with CS/customer: run the following scrub job for any copies going to customer:```python
# scrub example pseudo
def redact(record):
    for k in ['ssn','account_number','request_body']:
        if k in record: record[k] = '<REDACTED>'
    return record
```

james: note for ops audit: create a ticket in compliance tracker referencing incident 1852509876 and attach the access list and deletion schedule.

incident-bot: [SYSTEM] incident 1852509876 set severity=2, owner=james, sla_timer=rolling. oncall handoff logged.

liz: scheduled incident bridge in 10 minutes with customer + legal + infra. i'll post dial info in the bridge channel.

elain: will join bridge. after the bridge, legal will draft the retention exception memo template and circulate for signatures.

james: next steps I will do: (1) confirm snapshot integrity and S3 upload, (2) create compliance ticket, (3) escalate to eng-runtime for RCA on why debug flag propagated in a prod rollout.

raj: note for postmortem: add a checklist item to gate debug flag changes by environment label and require canary on non-prod first.

maria: creating a quick follow-up PR to enforce sidecar debug defaults to false and add a kill-switch toggle under admin API.

harbor-cust-pmo: thanks team. please keep us tightly looped; security wants to see the deletion certificate once done.

james: will update thread with s3 URL and audit log IDs once copy completes. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: [UPDATE] snapshot upload completed to s3://rwd-incident-quarantine/harborbank/1852509876 — access restricted, audit-entry=log-1852509876-01

james: uploaded. sending deletion schedule and compliance ticket. closing live mitigation phase, moving to forensic analysis + RCA.

ell: (bot-like) reminder to generate deletion cert after 72h window.

james: closing notes: no customer data exported externally, temporary exception approved by legal + customer, retention window 72h, deletion certificate required. will file postmortem and follow-up on rollout process.
